**Dear [Customer Name],**

As a valued member of the FLS community, you deserve more than just exceptional performance – you deserve exclusive rewards.

For a limited time, we're offering you **20% off** your next purchase from our premium collection of windproof, high-performance lighters. This offer is being extended to select customers only and won't be available to the general public.

### REDEEM YOUR EXCLUSIVE DISCOUNT:

Simply use code **[EXCLUSIVE20]** at checkout to apply your savings to any full-priced item in our collection.

[SHOP NOW AND SAVE]

### PERFECT TIMING TO:

- **Upgrade** your everyday carry with our latest innovations
- **Explore** our Signature Series with its enhanced ergonomic design
- **Gift** an FLS lighter to someone who appreciates quality and performance
- **Stock up** on your favorite model in multiple colorways

### WHY FLS CONTINUES TO LEAD:

Our commitment to excellence hasn't changed. Every FLS lighter still delivers the perfect balance of reliability, comfort, and style that you've come to expect:

- Wind-resistant technology that performs in any environment
- Ergonomic curved base for ultimate comfort and stability
- Premium construction for lasting durability
- Sleek design that makes a statement

This exclusive offer expires on **[Expiration Date]**, so don't miss your opportunity to enhance your collection at a special rate reserved for our most valued customers.

[REDEEM MY 20% DISCOUNT]

Thank you for your continued loyalty to FLS.

Ignite your savings,

**The FLS Team**
